minimum_wage.next_change: Rates are indexed annually to the Ontario Consumer Price Index; any new rate is published on or before April 1 and takes effect October 1. Next change would take effect 2027-10-01.
minimum_wage.notes: Confirmed against the live ontario.ca page (Your guide to the Employment Standards Act — Minimum wage) on 2026-11-16. The chart figures in the existing job chart ($17.95 general / $16.90 student, effective Oct 1, 2026) are correct and current. Note: a student who works MORE than 28 hours/week while school is in session is paid the general rate, not the student rate.
minimum_wage.student_rate_rule: Applies to students under 18 who work 28 hours a week or less when school is in session, or who work during a school break or summer holidays.
